topic: Weather Elements, Instruments, and Local Weather Charts
key_concepts: Weather is described by elements such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind d
Air temperature is measured with a thermometer.
Air pressure is measured with a barometer, including mercury and aneroid types.
Wind speed is measured with an anemometer.
Wind direction is determined with a wind vane.
Rainfall over a given time is measured with a rain gauge.
Humidity is measured with a psychrometer.
Cloud cover or cloudiness can be measured with a nephelometer.
Common cloud types include cirrus, cumulus, nimbus, and stratus clouds.
Weather charts and weather maps use symbols to record and interpret current weather.
